Ministry of MSME

Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)

PMEGP is a credit-linked subsidy scheme administered by the Ministry of MSME to generate employment opportunities through establishment of micro enterprises.

Objective

To generate employment opportunities in rural and urban areas through setting up of new self-employment ventures/projects/micro enterprises.

Eligibility

Any individual above 18 years of age. At least VIII standard pass for projects above a specified cost. Self Help Groups and institutions registered under the Societies Registration Act are also eligible.

Benefits

Margin money subsidy ranging from 15% to 35% of the project cost depending on category and area of the applicant.

Financial Assistance

Maximum project cost of Rs. 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs. 20 lakh for service sector.

Application Process

Applicants must apply online through the official PMEGP e-portal, after which the application is scrutinised by the concerned implementing agency.

Documents Required

  • Proof of identity
  • Proof of residence
  • Project report
  • Caste certificate, if applicable

Implementing Agency

Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), State KVIB, and District Industries Centres.
